response.overview: It tells the story of Inspector Nuar Ishak (Syafiq Kyle) who discovers the body of a woman named Balqis and Qistina (Sweet Qismina), twin sisters who were trapped in a residence and require a thorough investigation by the police force led by Inspector Nuar. Since then, Inspector Nuar Ishak's life is constantly disturbed by various strange occurrences, and every person connected to the case begins to die one by one. Alongside his problems with his twin sister Nur (Mimi Lana) and his increasingly deteriorating judgment, Nuar must solve the case before more lives are lost.
response.title: Sinopsis filem Pusaka
